system.description:
Thrown weapon: Weapon Power is added to the thrower’s Power to factor IMS, then the DoF determines the damage. Fight actions: Throw or Snapshot. Throwing weapons like knives or javelins cost 3 rps. The sample thrown weapon (p. 469) lists a 10 pace maximum range for throwing knives; the range table gives 30 paces for thrown weapons.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 558
